person: Nyokabi Mwangi, product manager at Tandaza Pay, a small payments fintech in Nairobi, renovating her flat (Mvule Court, Flat 4B) with a building crew while she stays at her sister's

mail.subject: Mvule Court 4B – final quote
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi, attached is the final quote for the kitchen and bathroom works: KES 1,240,000 in total. Stage 1 (demolition and plumbing first fix) is covered by the 30% deposit you paid. Stage 2 (tiling and screeding) is KES 372,000 and stage 3 (finishing and snagging) is the balance. We start demolition tomorrow at 8am. Regards, Kiprono

mail.subject: Tiling dates
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi, the screed is drying well. We plan to start tiling on the Monday after next, so the tiles must be on site by the Friday before. Please confirm your floor tile this weekend. Kiprono

mail.subject: Pipes invoice
mail.body: Hello Nyokabi, first fix plumbing is done. My invoice for pipes and fittings is KES 38,500, payable within 14 days. I will come back to fit the shower mixer once the tiles are up. Abdi

mail.subject: Contractor access rules
mail.body: Dear residents, contractors may work 8am to 5pm on weekdays and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays, with no work on Sundays. Each flat with contractors must pay a KES 5,000 refundable fob deposit and return the signed access form to the management office. Regards, Grace Njeri, Property Manager

mail.subject: Order KT-88213 confirmed
mail.body: Thank you for your order: 42 sqm Savanna Grey porcelain floor tile (60x60) and 9 sqm Ocean Mist wall tile. Total KES 187,600, paid in full. Delivery to Mvule Court in 3 days, between 10:00 and 14:00. Someone must be on site to sign for it.

mail.subject: Delivery change for KT-88213
mail.body: Our Friday trucks are fully booked, so your delivery is now on Saturday between 09:00 and 11:00. Someone must still be on site to sign. Sorry for the change.

mail.subject: Kitchen rewiring quote
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi, full kitchen rewiring with 8 new sockets and under-cabinet lighting comes to KES 96,000 including materials. I can hold this price for 10 days. Let me know so I can plan around the tilers. Joseph

mail.subject: Moodboard and a cabinet maker
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi! Moodboard attached. For the cabinets I'd go sage green or warm oak. I've put you in touch with Esther at Mbao Craft Joinery, she's brilliant and fair on price. Amani

mail.subject: Kitchen cabinets – quote MC-2219
mail.body: Dear Nyokabi, our quote for sage green kitchen cabinets with an oak worktop is KES 310,000. We need a 50% deposit before production starts, and production takes about 3 weeks. I will come to measure on Wednesday week at 10am. Esther Wekesa, Mbao Craft Joinery

mail.subject: Invoice INV-0457 – stage 2
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi, invoice INV-0457 for stage 2 (tiling and screeding) is attached: KES 372,000, due within 7 days. Please transfer to Langat & Sons Builders with reference MVULE-4B. Thanks, Kiprono

mail.subject: Mum's lunch Sunday
mail.body: Nyoks, I've booked Mukuyu Gardens for 1pm on Sunday for Mum's birthday, table for 6. Can you collect the cake? I ordered it from Tamu Bakes and it's paid, you just need to pick it up on Sunday morning. Love, W

mail.subject: Sunday
mail.body: My dear, Wambui tells me we are having lunch on Sunday. Please don't spend too much on me, a card is enough. And bring the photo album I lent you, I want to show Auntie Wairimu. Mama

mail.subject: Board deck – product section
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi, the board meets in two weeks. I need your product slides (roadmap, onboarding metrics, credit pilot) by next Friday so we can do a dry run. Five slides max. Thanks, Fatuma

mail.subject: Sprint review moved
mail.body: Team, I'm moving sprint review from Thursday to Friday at 11:00, since half of us are at the bank integration workshop on Thursday. Same room. Rahul

mail.subject: Onboarding prototype v3
mail.body: Hey Nyokabi, v3 of the merchant onboarding prototype is ready. Main change: KYC goes from 6 screens to 3. I'd love your comments before the review on Wednesday. Ama

mail.subject: Sandbox application – product description
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi, following our call this morning, the regulator wants a two-page description of the merchant credit pilot. Could you send me a draft by tomorrow evening? Their deadline is in 9 days. Ingrid

mail.subject: Coffee next week?
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi, great to see Tandaza's numbers this quarter. Would you be up for coffee next Thursday at 12:30 at Kahawa Loft? I'd love to hear about the credit pilot. Daniel Okafor, Mninga Ventures

mail.subject: Speaker registration confirmed
mail.body: Dear Nyokabi Mwangi, your speaker registration is confirmed. Ticket reference EAPS-2026-0417. Badge pickup is at the speakers' desk from 07:30 to 08:30 on the first morning. Please send your panel slides to the programme team 3 days before your panel. The speaker dinner is on the first evening at 19:00 at Umurage Rooftop.

mail.subject: Booking confirmed – QXT7LM
mail.body: Booking reference QXT7LM. Outbound SV 412 Nairobi to Kigali, departing 06:40, seat 14C. Return SV 415 Kigali to Nairobi, departing 18:15, seat 9A. One 23 kg checked bag included. Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure. Total paid USD 386.

mail.subject: Reservation IL-55190
mail.body: Dear Ms Mwangi, we look forward to welcoming you for 2 nights. Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 11:00. Our airport shuttle is USD 15 each way; please request it 48 hours ahead. Total USD 240, payable on arrival.

mail.subject: Leave approved
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi, your annual leave for the Monday after the payments summit is approved. You have 11 days of annual leave left this year.

mail.subject: Postmortem: last week's payout delay
mail.body: Hi all, the draft postmortem for last week's payout delay is in the shared folder. 2,140 merchant payouts were late by up to 4 hours. Please comment by Monday so we can review it on Tuesday week. Tomasz

mail.subject: Escalation: Baraka Hardware settlements
mail.body: Nyokabi, Baraka Hardware says three settlements this week arrived short by KES 2,300 each and they're threatening to leave. Can product look at how fees are shown? Ticket SUP-7781.

mail.subject: Your membership renews soon
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi, your monthly membership renews in 5 days. KES 6,500 will be charged to your card ending 2291.

mail.subject: Appointment confirmation
mail.body: Dear Nyokabi, this confirms your check-up and clean with Dr Farah Ismail. Please arrive 10 minutes early and bring your previous X-rays. The fee is KES 4,500, payable at the clinic.

mail.subject: Saturday long run – 18 km
mail.body: Striders! This Saturday is our 18 km long run. Meet at the north gate of Mutundu Forest at 06:30. Bring water; there's one water stop at 9 km. Coach Ochieng

mail.subject: Your bill is ready
mail.body: Account 40021187. Amount due: KES 3,240. Due in 7 days. Use your account number as the payment reference.

mail.subject: Relocation request FL-30912
mail.body: Hello Nyokabi, we've received your request to move your home internet back to Mvule Court 4B. A technician can visit any weekday between 9am and 4pm once the renovation is finished. Reply with a date or call us. Request number FL-30912.

mail.subject: Saturday dinner!
mail.body: Habibti, table booked at Zaatar House for 7:30 on Saturday, my treat to celebrate your promotion. Bring Wambui if she's free? Leila

mail.subject: Your order has shipped
mail.body: Order DD-604118: round bathroom mirror (60 cm) and brushed brass basin tap. Total KES 24,900. Arriving in 4 to 6 days. Tracking code DDX-77-4412.

mail.subject: Damp in the bathroom wall
mail.body: Hi Nyokabi, when we opened the wall behind the shower we found damp. We need to waterproof it before tiling: an extra KES 45,000 and one more day. I'll show you at tomorrow's site visit. Kiprono

mail.subject: Paint colours
mail.body: For the living room I'm thinking Chalk Linen on the walls and Deep Moss on the feature wall. You'll need about 12 litres of Chalk Linen and 4 of Deep Moss. Rangi Bora on Muthithi Lane stocks both.

mail.subject: Policy HC-118204 renewal
mail.body: Your home contents policy HC-118204 expires in 16 days. The renewal premium is KES 18,750. Please note: renovations over KES 1,000,000 must be declared before renewal.

mail.subject: Agenda for our 1:1
mail.body: For tomorrow: 1) credit pilot launch date, 2) hiring a second PM, 3) your summit panel. Could you bring the pilot's go/no-go criteria? Rahul

mail.subject: Merchant usability sessions
mail.body: We've recruited 5 merchants for usability sessions on Tuesday next week, 10:00 to 13:00 at the office, 30 minutes each. Each merchant gets a KES 1,500 voucher. Can you sit in on at least two?

mail.subject: Water tank cleaning
mail.body: Dear residents, the rooftop tanks will be cleaned on Thursday. Water will be off from 9am to 3pm. Please let your contractors know. Grace Njeri

mail.subject: Skip booking TH-2290
mail.body: Your 6-yard skip will be delivered to Mvule Court tomorrow morning. Hire is 14 days and the KES 12,000 is paid. Each extra day costs KES 900. We collect on the last day unless you extend.

mail.subject: Re: Mum's lunch Sunday
mail.body: Also, Mukuyu Gardens moved us to 1:30 because of a wedding. Cake pickup at Tamu Bakes is from 9am, and they close at noon on Sundays. W

mail.subject: Transfer successful
mail.body: Your transfer of KES 187,600 to Kigwa Tiles & Stone was successful. Reference KT-88213. Available balance: KES 412,350.

mail.subject: Re: Board deck – product section
mail.body: Small change: can I have your slides by Thursday at 6pm instead? The investors want the pre-read a day earlier. Fatuma

mail.subject: Shower mixer
mail.body: Morning Nyokabi, Kiprono says the tiles go up from Monday. I can fit the shower mixer and the basin tap on Thursday next week at 8am, if the tap has arrived by then. Abdi

calendar.title: Panel: Merchant credit in East Africa

reminders.title: Reply to Joseph about the rewiring quote
Return signed access form and fob deposit to Grace
Send sandbox product description to Ingrid
Send panel slides to the summit programme team
Renew home insurance and declare the renovation
Book airport taxi for the Kigali flight
Call Fiberlink about moving the line back
Bring the photo album to Mum's lunch
